title: Shiva Cinematic Odyssey
overview: A high-octane visual journey following extreme freeriders in the Himalayas. The goal was to translate the sheer terror and beauty of high-altitude riding into a cohesive, heart-racing 2-minute film.
process: Footage ingestion & multi-cam syncing of RED V-Raptor and drone rushes.
Developing a rhythm-based narrative cut matching the sound design beat.
Applying custom film-print LUT emulation and heavy grain mapping in DaVinci Resolve.
challenges: Managing 12TB of mixed-resolution 8K RAW footage while working remotely with tight deadlines, and designing soundscapes with minimal ambient audio recorded on-site.
solutions: Created a lightweight proxy workflow and built a sound library from scratch, utilizing Foley and synthesizers to recreate high-altitude winds and snowboard crunching.

feedback.text: The pacing of this cut is absolutely masterclass. It feels like watching a features film. The sound design is tactile and powerful.
feedback.author: Marcus Thorne

title: Lost in Kyoto
overview: An editorial exploration of Kyoto's night-life. Shot on Sony FX3, this piece focuses on neon contrast, rain reflections, and slow-shutter motion design to evoke a dreamlike state.
process: Assembled a non-linear storyline centered on sensory impressions.
Crafted a binaural soundscape of Japanese streets, rain, and distant train stations.
Graded with high contrast curves to emphasize neon reflections in wet streets.
challenges: Kyoto's narrow streets presented low lighting, resulting in noise in dark shadow regions.
solutions: Used temporal noise reduction nodes in DaVinci Resolve and mapped custom grain overlays to blend the noise texture into a filmic aesthetic.

feedback.text: Every frame feels like a painting. This edit captures the essence of Kyoto in a way that feels incredibly intimate.
feedback.author: Yuki Tanaka

title: Cyberpunk Future Promo
overview: A high-energy editing layout utilizing heavy match-cuts, datamoshing, and 3D camera projections to market a futuristic gaming title.
process: Integrating 3D Blender camera tracking with live-action footage.
Crafting rhythmic, dynamic visual transitions utilizing speed ramps and zoom blurs.
Synthesizing glitch audio and deep sub-drops for immersive sound impact.
challenges: Blending cinematic game models with raw video files without making the CG elements look out of place.
solutions: Implemented matching lens distortion, matched focal lengths in Blender, and applied global color grading and film grain in DaVinci Resolve.

feedback.text: A breathtaking trailer. The speed ramps and visual transitions are incredibly sharp and energetic.
feedback.author: Adam Kiciński

title: Echoes of Silence
overview: A quiet, patient documentary about the melting glaciers in Iceland, focusing on long wide-shots, ambient sound, and color precision to highlight the dramatic impact of climate change.
process: Created a slow-paced cut focused on long, breathtaking atmospheric shots.
Applied a natural, desaturated color grading process focusing on blues, cyans, and cold whites.
Layered delicate wind and hydrophone-recorded melting ice sounds.
challenges: Keeping the audience engaged during long, silent shots without losing the cinematic tension.
solutions: Used micro-movements, subtle scale zooms in post-production, and cross-fading sound design to create an underlying sensory rhythm.

feedback.text: Stunning work. The editing respects the silence of the glacier and tells a powerful visual story.
feedback.author: Sarah Jenkins
